title: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 1
description: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 1 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Mage Equipment Token Master

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Sir Ving N'Seacressy indicated that someone has been passing counterfeit King's Coins to the Token Masters in Townston. He then signaled that he wants you to investigate, starting with interviews of all three Token Masters. Also, he asked you to bring him back a snack if you pass a restaurant.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Mage Equipment Token Master

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 2a

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Sir Ving N'Seacressy indicated that someone has been passing counterfeit King's Coins to the Token Masters in Townston. He then signaled that he wants you to investigate, starting with interviews of all three Token Masters. Also, he asked you to bring him back a snack if you pass a restaurant.

Offer:

*Sir Ving N'Seacressy extends his left arm away from his body, then lets it drop* *Sir Ving N'Seacressy looks at you, closes one eye, and touches one finger of his right hand to his left ear.* When traveling through a smithy, it is best to not leave one's body exposed.

Turn-in:

I'm the Mage Token Master. Can I help you?

Level range: 47–100
